CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, March 18, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE FEBRUARY 18, 2026 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  March 18, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, February 18, 2026
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:08 P.M. on Wednesday, February 18, 2026 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall,
111 South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, Commission Member Love, and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: None.
Staff Present: Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Boettcher, and Clerical
Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE NOVEMBER 19, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano,
the November 19, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
Vice President Saunders and Commission Member Hermano will meet with Donna to discuss
Alhambra photographs and quotes soon; no other updates from the Commissioners.

STAFF REPORT
The City Art and Cultural Events Commission approved Shahla Reynolds, Fernando Reyes, and
Jim Newberry to exhibit in the Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery for 2026.

Deputy Director Houghton shared that the city is accepting entries for the Tournament of Roses
Parade Float Design Art Contest up until March 5, 2026 and next month the Arts and Cultural
Events Commission will select the winner.

Recreation Supervisor Boettcher invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission and their families to attend the Lunar New Year Festival held on Main Street in
conjunction with the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce on February 28, 2026 and the annual
Peeps and Pedals held at Alhambra Park on March 28, 2026.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.
 ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Love, the
February 18, 2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:20 P.M.
